risks.title: Impact of drug pricing reforms (IRA)
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) and its impacts on drug pricing and reimbursement. The company had to take steps to qualify for exceptions, highlighting the significance and uncertainty of these regulations.

risks.title: Dependence on cabozantinib revenues
risks.score_rationale: Sales of cabozantinib (CABOMETYX and COMETRIQ) represent 91% of net product revenues (2,122,804k). This concentration on a single pharmaceutical asset exposes the company to significant risks in case of issues with this product or the emergence of generics.

risks.title: Potential failures in new drug development
risks.score_rationale: The company is investing 825 million in R&D in 2025. It is heavily investing in its pipeline, citing several ongoing clinical trials for zanzalintinib (FDA decision December 2026) and other molecules (XB010, XB371, XB628, XB002). Trial failures or program discontinuations represent a major financial and strategic risk.

risks.title: Increased competition in oncology
risks.score_rationale: The oncology sector is highly competitive, with numerous companies developing innovative therapies. The text mentions risks posed by competitors in cancer treatment and the presence of many players with alternative therapeutic approaches.

risks.title: Dependence on international commercialization partners
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on Ipsen for markets outside the United States and Japan (Ipsen revenues 165.9 million in 2025) and Takeda for Japan (revenues 13.2 million). These partners have commercialized CABOMETYX in 68 countries. Their performance and strategy directly impact international revenues.

risks.title: Regulatory and approval uncertainties
risks.score_rationale: The drug approval process is lengthy and uncertain. Zanzalintinib is currently under FDA review with a target decision date in December 2026. Delays or rejection of approvals constitute a major risk for the future pipeline.

risks.title: Risks related to clinical trials and data
risks.score_rationale: The success of future products depends on results from major clinical trials (STELLAR-303, STELLAR-304 for zanzalintinib). Mixed or inconclusive results could affect development and the product's perception by regulatory authorities.

ai_positioning.summary: Exelixis does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. The information provided focuses on financial aspects, oncology products, and collaborations, with no reference to AI.
